verdict.rationale: Mastra provides a local/hosted Studio for testing agents and inspecting runs (mastra-docs-50, mastra-docs-56) and an isolated sandbox for tool execution (mastra-docs-34), which supports dev/test workflows separate from a deployed production instance, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox environment or data isolation guarantee that keeps test runs from touching production data stores. missing for 10: explicit sandbox-vs-production environment separation, documentation on data isolation/test fixtures, and confirmation that Studio/testing runs never touch production databases.
